create_memory_saver_adapter: create a torch memory saver adapter instance with enable flag to get real or noop implementation
configure_subprocess_memory: configure torch memory saver for subprocess usage via the adapter
save_memory_region: save memory in a tagged region with optional CPU backup using the adapter region method
pause_resume_memory_region: pause and resume memory saving for a specific tag using the adapter pause and resume methods
check_memory_saver_status: check if torch memory saver is enabled and valid before using memory-saving features
